mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting bone cells to blood vessels was most worthwhile: the channels showed how living cells inside hard bone receive nutrients.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final assembly became a little repetitive because each of the last three combinations was the only offered action.

surprise.text: I hadn't pictured nutrients reaching bone cells through tiny fluid-filled channels while blood cells stay in the vessel.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures gave each part a clear job, even when I followed the only available pairing.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing the bone's living parts and the joint's protective parts come together made me curious about how other body structures work.
